text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There is also monocytosis, basophilia, and increased red cell distribution width. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and/or infectious/inflammatory processes, possible bone marrow suppression or dysfunction, and early renal involvement. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
